output.reason: The migration guide [ev-d6a3846e479f] only says the `preferServerCipherSuites` option "has been removed". It does not say whether configurations that still set it are rejected, silently ignored, or fail at load. The schema validator found that TLSOption spec.preferServerCipherSuites is still in the v3.0.0 CRD schema [ev-011956bb7059]. That goes against the proposed claim that TLSOption resources are rejected by validation, so resource-rejected is not supported. To decide between setting-ignored and another failure kind, we need upstream text or code showing what Traefik v3 does when the option is set.
